claim: The pipeline reconstructs 563 persistent AQS 88101 Method Code anchors.
limitation: Method Code is reported metadata, not a physical instrument log.

claim: A common cross-site comparison is available for 228 of 563 anchors.
limitation: 325 anchors lack three qualified distinct physical donor sites and 10 have input-window failures.

claim: The stable synthetic benchmark has 400 independent evaluation samples per local or matched regional perturbation variant, using 66 calibration and 80 evaluation physical target sites with disjoint complete target-plus-donor input footprints.
limitation: Results are limited to the defined stable PM2.5 windows and perturbation model.

claim: Standard synthetic control outperforms MetaShift on aggregate attribution AUPRC, macro-F1, and regional FPR.
limitation: This does not establish universal performance outside this benchmark.

claim: Cross-validated MetaShift has lower point-estimate MAE than standard synthetic control but not confidence-supported.
limitation: Cluster bootstrap intervals condition on the benchmark and do not prove no possible advantage.

claim: 34 real anchors meet the FDR-screened exploratory candidate-discontinuity evidence rule.
limitation: Evidence tier is observational and not a physical-causality label.

claim: Hourly same-site POC differences are available for nine candidate events and match daily direction in eight; QA collocation lacks strong matched pre/post validation.
limitation: POC is not physical-instrument ground truth, and qualifier availability varies.

claim: The 88502 sensitivity pipeline is independently executable but too sparse for strong generalization.
limitation: Only three common-method comparisons are complete.

claim: Selection-aware nested intervals are more conservative than fixed-weight intervals for real MetaShift candidates.
limitation: Nested intervals condition on the observed candidate pool and do not capture all metadata or candidate-pool uncertainty.

claim: A targeted review of 20 official-document cases found zero dated site-specific confirmations.
limitation: No located notice is not evidence that no physical change occurred.
